atoms.a: All of my friends are out of town, and I have nothing to do today.
Her friend suddenly stops talking to her, and she doesn’t understand the reason why.
My little sister thinks there is a monster under her bed.
It’s his first presentation, and everyone is watching him.
He is finally done with all of his exams and has nothing to worry about anymore.

trainers.instruction: Listen to the situation and choose the option that fits best.

b.sound: He is probably feeling lonely because he spends most of his time alone. He doesn’t know anyone here and he misses his old friends.
He is probably feeling happy because now he gets to spend all of his time in his room.

atoms.sound: This is our first month in a new city. My little brother is having trouble making friends. He spends a lot of time in his room and often seems bored. I wonder how he feels about all of this.

b.sound: He is probably feeling relaxed and happy because now he doesn’t have to deal with the stress and pressure of his job.
He is probably feeling frustrated and sad because his job is something really important to him, and he doesn’t have it anymore.

atoms.sound: My partner is losing his job right now. He has been doing this job for a very long time and he really cares about and loves his job. I wonder how he feels right now.

b.sound: She is probably feeling very happy and relaxed because she has an excuse to not study today.
She is probably feeling nervous and frustrated right now. She needs to study as much as she can, and for that, she needs a space where she can focus.

atoms.sound: My sister is studying for a very important exam. She really cares about it, but we have guests at home, and they are really loud. I wonder how she feels about that.
